title_en: Technology and Engineering (11/20): The Smartphone Assembly Line
note_en: 被 (bèi) marks the passive, putting the thing acted on first: 这台手机就会被送回生产线 "the phone is sent back to the line." English passives need "be" plus a past participle, but Chinese verbs don't change form, so 被 alone signals the passive; this text uses it constantly (被组装完成, 被加热, 被赋予) because factory writing focuses on what happens to the product.
